C1779.title: OBD-II Dongle Vulnerabilities Exploited to Access Vehicle Location and Diagnostic Data
C1779.summary: Security researchers discovered vulnerabilities in OBD-II dongles that allow attackers to obtain vehicle location, diagnostic data, and CAN bus traffic, demonstrating the practical risk of abusing the onboard diagnostic interface to steal sensitive driving data.
